वृन्दा १

VṚNDĀ I . Wife of the asura named jalandhara. (See under māyāśiva).

वृन्दा २

VṚNDĀ II . See under svarṇā.

वृन्दारक १

VṚNDĀRAKA I . One of the hundred sons of dhṛtarāṣṭra. It is mentioned in mahābhārata. droṇa parva, Chapter 127, Stanza 33, that he was killed by Bhīmasena in the battle of bhārata.

वृन्दारक २

VṚNDĀRAKA II . A warrior who fought on the side of the kauravas against the pāṇḍavas. abhimanyu killed this warrior. (M.B. droṇa parva, Chapter 47, Stanza 12).
